H6430: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H7925: literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning
H796: an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H3772: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7535: properly, leanness, i.e. (figuratively) limitation; only adverbial, merely, or conjunctional, although
H7604: properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1869: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)
H3548: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H3513: to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses)
H8074: to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H6076: a tumor; also a mound, i.e. fortress
H1366: properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H7185: properly, to be dense, i.e. tough or severe (in various applications)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H622: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H6996: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H6139: an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
